Grade Analysis Tool

This is to certify that the project work submitted by the student is a bonafide record of work carried out under the guidance of the faculty of the Department of Computer Engineering and Technology. The work has not been submitted elsewhere for the award of any degree or diploma.

We would like to thank our guide and the head of the department for their constant support and encouragement throughout this project.

The tool reads marks for each student and reports the mean, median, highest and lowest score using the statistics module. Letter grades follow fixed cut-offs of 90, 75, 60 and 40.

Approximate string matching compares two strings by counting the minimum number of single-character edits needed to change one into the other. This measure, known as the Levenshtein distance, is widely used in spelling correction and record linkage.

We used it to match student names typed with small spelling mistakes against the class list, which reduced unmatched names from 9 to 2 in our test file of 120 rows.

The search feature lowercases both the query and the stored fields so that matching ignores capital letters.
